about: The AE tactical SMG pack: CMT's TSC:E tactical SMG (the evolved set's smg_tactical: a suppressed SMG with a red-dot optic and a zoom; art, animations and sounds, credited) made into a donor map and the pack. The model CMT made carries first-person arms and two flashlight cones: the third-person model is it with the arms and the cones taken out, the first-person model the same (the arms in first person are the stock cyborg's) (make_pack.py's model_parts step: the model's last parts, byte for byte). Its firing is the BURST PDW's (0.9.4, the owner: "Tactical SMG should be the name keep the zoom and suppressed but merge the PDW's shooting behavior"): the engine's TACTICAL SMG profile (port/linux/game/ae_rifle_profiles.c, found by the weapon key) plays a burst a pull and writes the PDW's numbers, its own 2x zoom kept; its fire is the SUPPRESSED SMG's; its scope's lens reflects as the BATTLE RIFLE's; the stray magazine CMT's model carries on its first-person left arm is folded away. The zoom overlay is CMT's own with the labels left out. make_pack.py runs it; the locations of the zip, the stock map and the programs are given on its command line.

design.note: 0.9.4 revision 2: the BURST PDW's bursts (3 rounds a pull, a pull every 17 ticks); the owner's round 2 (11-16): four bursts kill a full-shield dummy

steps.why: the donor map: Blood Gulch's scenario without vehicles, the weapon in its weapon palette
the pickup and HUD message indices the stock assault rifle's (CMT's point into CMT's own HUD texts)
the Xbox's model format; its parts had no compressed vertices, which the Xbox's build needs
The prompts' picture is CMT's own: its pickup icon sheet, sequence 15 (the silenced SMG).
the ammunition panel: the counter of 60 rounds (counter_art.py), the low-ammo flash on it, the prompts' picture off the screen
CMT's art is dark in stock CE's lighting: the base map brightened as the battle rifle's

the third-person model's source: CMT's tactical SMG without its last three parts, the first-person arms (the ODST rubber material) and the two flashlight cones, and their three shaders (model_parts.py: byte for byte, nothing else of the tag changes: a JMS round trip drew the first-person rig wrong). 0.9.4: CMT's gun part also carries a spare magazine on the first-person left upper arm (108 vertices of part 0 on node 2), which the third-person model drew in its resting pose 0.34 units behind and below the gun (on the thigh holster it trailed the player, the owner: "it looks like a tac mag trailing the player"): its vertices folded onto one point inside the gun's body (node 1), so its faces draw nothing (model_parts.py collapse_vertices)

the first-person model's source: the same model without its last three parts, as the third-person one (CMT's ODST arms and the flashlight cones, and their three shaders), under its own tag name: the arms in first person are the stock cyborg's, as the other SMG packs have (owner 2026-11-04)
the Xbox's model format (Invader's gbxmodel to model)
the Xbox's model format (Invader's gbxmodel to model)

the body's lighting tuned beside the battle rifle's in the game; its reflection cube map was a campaign map's (levels\a10\bitmaps\cube map glass): the warthog's metal cube map, which every stock multiplayer map has, as the battle rifle's metal
its reflection cube map is a campaign map's (levels\a10\bitmaps\cube map glass): the stock cyborg's mirror cube map, which every stock multiplayer map has, as the battle rifle's silencer shader

the scope's lens as AE's other scopes have it (0.9.4, the owner: "it isn't reflecting like the rest of our scopes do"): the BATTLE RIFLE's and the DMR's lens reflection, CMT's blue forerunner interior cube map in a light blue head on (0.57 0.78 1) and none at a glancing angle; CMT's own (the grunt's cube map, white both ways) gave a flat grey mirror

CMT's interface with the ammunition panel ours (the child HUD), the hip aiming reticle ours (the SMG's, drawn from geometry, in CE's colour, red on target) and the zoom overlay CMT's own lines without the labels (smg_scope.py); the second reticle, the zoomed one, left out (the scope's lines are the zoomed sight) and the hip reticle kept on through the zoom (0.9.4, the owner: no crosshair when zoomed; CMT's hid it there) and CMT's zoom screen effect (a green night-vision tint and a blur, which the other packs' scopes have none of) taken off

0.9.4 (the owner after his round: "Tactical SMG should be the name keep the zoom and suppressed but merge the PDW's shooting behavior"): the BURST PDW's numbers, which the engine's TACTICAL SMG profile writes over these as the map starts (port/linux/game/ae_rifle_profiles.c; its pack plays its tags' behaviour and is found by its weapon key): a plain trigger at 30 rounds a second (a burst's 3 rounds a tick apart, the burst and its 12-tick recovery the engine's), a magazine of 36 with 144 to start and 144 in reserve at most, error 0.6 to 1.6 degrees, a tracer every third round (one a burst), aim assist 3 degrees / 12 units and magnetism 6 / 16; its own zoom kept, one level at 2x (CMT's 3x; the SMG's range does not need more), the zoom sounds the stock sniper rifle's; its fire the SUPPRESSED SMG's (CMT's two suppressed fire effects in turn: their sounds and the silenced muzzle flare; the model carries a suppressor); the bullet the SMG's (edited below); the held weapon's collision and melee the stock assault rifle's, its damage and response tags left to the map; no night vision; CMT's flashlight attachment left out (nothing in the first-person model lights); the second pack's ammunition box (the SMG's)

The tactical SMG's bullet (0.9.4: the BURST PDW's, which the engine's profile writes too): 400 units a second slowing to 240 over the air damage range's 2-unit span (the SMG round's: full damage inside about 5 units, the lower past 6.5), reaching 40 units. Spartans' armour and skin take the stock assault rifle's smaller impact effects; CMT's tags give the metal_hollow material (5) their grunt armor's impact (grunt blood decal and particles, a flesh hit); stock and Xbox maps use metal_hollow for real floors and grates, so the hit takes the bullet's own metal_thin impact (6)

The tactical SMG's round (0.9.4: the BURST PDW's, which the engine's profile writes too): 16 a round at full speed, 11 once slowed, x1.0 on a Spartan's shield and body: a full player dies to 10 rounds up close (the 4th burst), 14 at mid range (the 5th); no head bonus

a bullet's kick on the pad (haptics, 2026-11-03): the SMG's light fast pulse on both motors, a little lighter for 0.06 s a round (15 a second: a soft buzz); CMT's view kick and shake are left as they are

expected.about: recorded from a build of revision 1 (2026-11-04: the first set of numbers, PROVISIONAL; the models cut from CMT's tactical SMG model, the zoom overlay CMT's lines without the labels); a pack built twice from the recipe was the same; re-pinned 2026-11-15 for 0.9.4's polish round 1: the hip reticle kept on through the zoom; 0.9.4 revision 2: the BURST PDW's firing, the suppressed fire, the blue scope lens, the stray magazine folded away (pinned from its box build 2026-11-16)
